decisions.reason: As a newly launched feature tightly linked to the firm's core digital identity offering, it is cheap to keep alive while customer demand and use cases become clearer.
A payment wallet is strategically relevant but commercially more uncertain and demanding, so management would likely keep the option open for now while monitoring adoption.
The NFC-based authenticator looks more niche and its market signal is still weak, but after only a short time on the market the firm would likely wait rather than exit immediately.
Its own dedicated page suggests stronger commitment, and a secure payment and wallet framework fits the firm's established capabilities and can be retained at relatively low option cost.
A secure mobile app platform is adjacent to the firm's core business and worth keeping while uncertainty about partner uptake and platform traction resolves.
An application shielding library is a core security product with clear reuse value across clients, making it a low-cost and attractive option to continue offering.
